description: Save the Reddit account the Social tab drafts for: username (optional), comment karma, account age (under1mo, 1to6mo, 6moto2yr or over2yr), goal, founderStory and tone. Karma and age decide whether drafts may mention your product; the reply returns the readiness tier (warmup or ready). Replaces the stored profile — send every field.

founderStory.description: Your real backstory. Drafts draw on it, in the first person, when it fits.

username.description: Your Reddit username, with or without u/

name: set_reddit_profile
